Initial release of Work Productivity Nano Banana Workflow Helper.

- Provides workflow and implementation support for users seeking Nano Banana Pro-style productivity solutions.
- Helps identify user requirements, creates work plans, checklists, or artifacts, and validates practical outputs.
- Prioritizes solutions that are friendly to local hardware and avoid cloud-only or resource-heavy approaches.
- Tailors responses to immediate user needs, with reusability and transparency in assumptions and limits.
- Activated by keywords related to "nano-banana", "work-productivity", and similar workflow requests.
